product_family: AI co-pilot for technical design and documentation — generates and maintains diagrams (architecture, entity relationships, flow charts, sequences). Includes markdown support, version history, API, and GitHub integration. Available in multi-tenant, single-tenant, and private cloud (BYOC) deployments.
trust_center_url: https://trust.eraser.io (referenced on vendor site as 'Visit trust portal')

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 type 2 certified and penetration tested annually

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on vendor domain. SOC 2 Type 2 is offered instead as primary information security certification.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No evidence of HIPAA compliance, BAA, or healthcare-specific certifications found on vendor domain.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy policy mentions 'no transfer of Your Personal Data will place to an organization or a country unless there are adequate controls in place' but no explicit GDPR compliance certification or DPA framework stated.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found. Eraser notes 'we will not store or collect Your payment card details' (Stripe handles payments).

certifications.name: ISO 27701 (Privacy)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on vendor domain.

privacy.ai_training_note: Vendor explicitly states: 'OpenAI nor Eraser will use your data to train AI models.' However, 'Eraser may analyze your usage to improve and enhance our AI feature.' OpenAI retains API requests/responses for up to 30 days per their usage policy.
privacy.data_region: Not explicitly specified; privacy policy states data processing may occur at 'Company's operating offices and in any other places where the parties involved in the processing are located.' Multi-tenancy default, but BYOC (private cloud) option available for data residency control.

security.name: Data Backup & Recovery
security.value: Version history & snapshots available; users responsible for independent backup of content

security.name: Encryption Details
security.value: Not publicly specified on vendor domain

security.name: Trust Portal Access
security.value: Available for enterprise customers; includes SOC 2 Type 2 report and annual penetration test report. Contact: hello@eraser.io

products.name: Eraser Core Platform
products.data_scope: Diagrams, design docs, markdown content, version history, user data
products.notes: Available in free, paid, and enterprise tiers. Supports architecture diagrams, ERDs, flow charts, sequence diagrams. API available. Markdown-based with export to PNG/SVG/PDF/MD.

products.name: DiagramGPT (AI Feature)
products.notes: Uses OpenAI API; neither Eraser nor OpenAI trains models on user data. OpenAI retains requests/responses up to 30 days.

products.name: MCP Server (Model Context Protocol)
products.notes: Launching MCP Server per homepage. Allows integration with other AI tools and workflows.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (free tier), subscription tiers, enterprise pricing available. No public pricing details for enterprise.
compare.data_residency: Not guaranteed by default (multi-tenant US-based). BYOC (private cloud) option available for on-premise or customer-controlled cloud deployment.

flags: No ISO 27001 certification — only SOC 2 Type 2 offered as primary security certification
No HIPAA compliance or BAA availability — healthcare/regulated use cases not explicitly supported
No explicit GDPR compliance statement or DPA framework — privacy policy addresses data transfers but no formal compliance posture stated
Data residency not guaranteed in multi-tenant default — international data transfers possible (US-based service providers); BYOC option mitigates for on-premise needs
Privacy policy mentions analytics data collection (Google Analytics, Amplitude) — may raise concerns for GDPR-sensitive organizations
Trust Portal not directly accessible online (must request via hello@eraser.io) — transparency slightly limited compared to vendors with public trust portals
Encryption details not publicly specified — best practices assumed but not documented on public pages
AI training policy clear but OpenAI 30-day retention of API requests/responses not widely advertised — could be concern for sensitive technical diagrams
